_read_me_first: TEMPLATE. Copy to tools/secret-patterns.local.json and edit THAT copy.
The .local.json file is gitignored and is the only place real secrets go.
Replace each REPLACE-THIS-WORD with the real value, keeping the quotes.
scan-staged.js refuses to run while any placeholder remains, so a
half-filled file can never be mistaken for a clean scan.
Matched as literal text, so . and $ in a password are safe.
ONLY list a secret that could plausibly end up in a file in this repo.
A secret that exists nowhere in the project does not belong here: listing
it writes it to disk in the clear to guard against something that cannot
happen, which is the exact risk this scanner exists to prevent. The
organiser passwords were removed for that reason on 2026-09-14, once they
no longer shipped inside the Format/ apps.
